capabilities: Render vertically aligned gloss lines from gloss and ngloss code blocks
Add numbering, labels, source text, and free translation lines to glosses
Write compact glosses with the alternative adjacent-element ngloss syntax
Customize gloss appearance with CSS classes, style options, and predefined overrides
Configure per-gloss options, defaults, element alignment, and fancy symbol replacement
extras: The README notes that the markup option is not implemented and causes an error if enabled, that the manual installation method is deprecated in favor of the community plugin repository, and that gloss numbering may be replaced with auto-numbering in the future.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to write linguistics-style interlinear glosses with morpheme-aligned lines inside notes.
summary: Renders interlinear glosses from gloss/ngloss code blocks, with vertically aligned elements, numbering, labels, and CSS style options.
